description: Cover names, emails, card numbers and other private details in screenshots. Give boxes in pixels (or 0–1 fractions of the width and height); the same boxes are applied to every file, for matching screenshots. "marker" (a hand-drawn stroke) and "solid" replace the pixels so nothing can be recovered; "pixelate" and "blur" look softer but short text like numbers can sometimes be guessed, so use marker or solid for card numbers and passwords. The image is re-drawn, so hidden metadata goes too. Saved as name-redacted.ext.

boxes.description: Areas to cover, measured on the image as it displays (upright).

height.description: Box height (pixels, or 0–1 of the height).

width.description: Box width (pixels, or 0–1 of the width).

x.description: Left edge (pixels, or 0–1 of the width with units "fraction").

y.description: Top edge (pixels, or 0–1 of the height).

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: "keep": PNG stays PNG (crisp text), WebP stays WebP, others become JPEG.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

style.description: marker (the site’s default, a hand-drawn stroke), solid block, pixelate or blur.

units.description: "px": boxes in pixels. "fraction": 0–1 of the width and height, which suits screenshots of different sizes.

name: redact_images
title: Redact screenshots
